boxes.label: Payments received for qualified tuition and related expenses
boxes.summary: What the school received for your tuition and required fees.
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 1 payments received for qualified tuition and related expenses education credit

boxes.label: Adjustments made for a prior year
boxes.summary: Refunds of tuition that was reported in an earlier year.
boxes.goesTo: Not entered directly; can mean repaying a prior-year education credit
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 4 adjustments made for a prior year refund of qualified education expenses credit recapture

boxes.label: Scholarships or grants
boxes.summary: Scholarships and grants the school processed for you.
boxes.goesTo: Reduces expenses on Form 8863; any taxable part goes on Schedule 1, line 8r
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 5 scholarships or grants taxable scholarship Schedule 1 line 8r

boxes.label: Adjustments to scholarships or grants for a prior year
boxes.summary: Changes to scholarships that were reported in an earlier year.
boxes.goesTo: Not entered directly; can change a prior-year education credit
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 6 adjustments to scholarships or grants for a prior year

boxes.label: Box 1 includes amounts for an academic period beginning January–March 2026
boxes.summary: Some payments were for a term that starts early next year.
boxes.goesTo: Form 8863 (expenses paid in 2025 for a term starting Jan–Mar 2026 count for 2025)
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 7 academic period beginning January through March prepaid expenses

boxes.label: Check if at least half-time student
boxes.summary: You took at least half a full course load.
boxes.goesTo: Form 8863 (the American opportunity credit requires at least half-time enrollment)
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 8 at least half-time student American opportunity credit

boxes.label: Check if a graduate student
boxes.summary: Whether you were in a graduate-level program.
boxes.goesTo: Form 8863 (helps show which education credit you can claim)
boxes.retrievalQuery: Form 1098-T box 9 graduate student first four years of postsecondary education
